description: This file contains client-side API utility functions for a React-based dashboard application. It includes functions to resolve the API base URL, fetch JSON data from various endpoints, normalize data shapes, and retrieve module overviews and metrics for the dashboard.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given URL with error handling for non-JSON responses and HTTP errors.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array for consistent processing.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, attempting multiple endpoints and deriving minimal data if necessary.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total metrics for the dashboard overview, including total users and deployed applications.
